relations.note: Susanoo battles Orochi after rendering its eight heads helpless with liquor.
Susanoo dismembers Orochi with a sword after it drinks and sleeps.

relations.myth: Aki river and unborn child variant
relations.note: Susanoo respectfully feeds Orochi liquor in all eight mouths before killing it.

relations.myth: Annual consumption of the divine daughters
relations.note: Orochi annually consumes his daughters, leaving only the final threatened child.
He helps prepare the liquor and trap that render Orochi helpless.

relations.myth: Annual consumption of the divine daughters
relations.note: Orochi annually consumes her daughters, leaving only the final threatened child.
She participates in preparing the liquor and trap used against Orochi.
Orochi is expected to consume her, but Susanoo transforms and hides her.

relations.myth: Annual consumption of the divine daughters
relations.note: Orochi eats one unnamed daughter of Ashinazuchi and Tenazuchi each year.

relations.myth: Aki river and unborn child variant
relations.note: Orochi approaches to consume her at birth but is diverted and killed.
Later Gion commentators sometimes equate Orochi with this poisonous-serpent deity.
